# District 5 Elections

States of Jersey elections held in District 5 — St Helier Central — since 2022:

- **[Deputies Elections](https://flow.je/elections/district-5#deputies)**

* * *

* * *

## Deputies Elections

The 2022 elections are the first to utilise the new electoral districts.

* * *

### 2022 Deputies Election

Election for the role of Deputy (4 seats), 22nd June 2022.

**[Carina Alves](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/carina-alves), [Rob Ward](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/rob-ward), [Catherine Curtis](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/catherine-curtis), [Lyndsay Feltham](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/lyndsay-feltham) and [Geoff Southern](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/geoff-southern) were elected as Deputies of District 5 in 2022.**

|  | Name | Party | Votes |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **[Carina Alves](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/carina-alves)** | Reform Jersey | 961 | 62.7% |
| 2 | **[Rob Ward](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/rob-ward)** | Reform Jersey | 937 | 61.1% |
| 3 | **[Catherine Curtis](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/catherine-curtis)** | Reform Jersey | 847 | 55.3% |
| 4 | **[Lyndsay Feltham](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/lyndsay-feltham)** | Reform Jersey | 836 | 54.5% |
| 5 | **[Geoff Southern](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/geoff-southern)** | Reform Jersey | 734 | 47.9% |
| 6 | [John Baker](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/john-baker) |  | 524 | 34.2% |
| 7 | [Neil Kilbey](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/neil-kilbey) |  | 436 | 28.4% |
| 8 | [Chris Tanguy](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/chris-tanguy) | Jersey Alliance | 430 | 28% |
| 9 | [Julie Wallman](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/julie-wallman) | Advance Jersey | 358 | 23.4% |

1,533 ballots (inc. 9 spoilt papers)

5,284 registered voters

29% turnout

* * *

### 2026 Deputies Election

Election for the role of Deputy (4 seats), 7th June 2026.

- [Carina Alves](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/carina-alves) : Current Deputy of District 5 (Reform Jersey) \[[jerseyeveningpost.com](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2026/04/08/assistant-chief-minister-to-seek-re-election/)\]
- [Lee Carpenter](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/lee-carpenter) : New Candidate (Reform Jersey) \[[jerseyeveningpost.com](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2026/04/11/green-finance-expert-to-stand-for-reform-jersey/)\]
- [Catherine Curtis](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/catherine-curtis) : Current Deputy of District 5 (Reform Jersey) \[[jerseyeveningpost.com](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2026/03/31/reform-jersey-deputy-to-seek-second-term/)\]
- [Lyndsay Feltham](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/lyndsay-feltham) : Current Deputy of District 5 (Reform Jersey) \[[jerseyeveningpost.com](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2026/04/10/still-much-more-to-do-says-social-security-minister-ahead-of-re-election-bid/)\]
- [Robin Ward](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/robin-ward) : New Candidate \[[jerseyeveningpost.com](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2026/04/21/a-tale-of-two-wards-in-st-helier-central/)\]
